dsh-credentials-vault is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. HashiCorp Vault backend for the credential seam: KV v2/v1, AppRole machine auth, per-operation reads so rotation needs no restart, and compare-and-swap writes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-eeddc687ee6b22ba8221.html
